points.title: 皇室教育
points.description: 玛丽亚·特蕾西亚出生于维也纳哈布斯堡王朝，是查理六世的长女。她接受了全面的教育，包括语言、音乐、舞蹈、政治和军事知识。尽管父亲通过《1713年国事诏书》试图确保她的继承权，但欧洲列强对此表示质疑。这段时期她学习了如何管理一个庞大而复杂的帝国，为后来的统治奠定了基础。她与洛林的弗朗茨·斯蒂芬结婚，这段婚姻后来成为她政治生涯的重要支持。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Vienna to the Habsburg dynasty, Maria Theresa was the eldest daughter of Charles VI. She received a comprehensive education including languages, music, dance, politics, and military knowledge. Despite her father's Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 attempting to secure her inheritance, European powers questioned it. During this period, she learned to govern the vast and complex empire, laying the foundation for her future reign. She married Francis Stephen of Lorraine, whose support would prove crucial in her political career.

points.title: 王位继承战争
points.description: 1740年查理六世去世后，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚继承奥地利王位，但立即面临普鲁士、法国、西班牙和巴伐利亚等国的挑战。她加冕为匈牙利和波西米亚女王，获得了这些地区的支持。在战争中，她展现出非凡的领导才能，亲自前往前线鼓舞士气。1745年丈夫弗朗茨·斯蒂芬当选神圣罗马帝国皇帝，成为她的重要政治盟友。1748年《亚琛和约》确认了她的继承权，但西里西亚被普鲁士占领，这一损失成为她后来与普鲁士冲突的根源。
points.descriptionEn: Upon Charles VI's death in 1740, Maria Theresa inherited the Austrian throne but immediately faced challenges from Prussia, France, Spain, and Bavaria. She was crowned Queen of Hungary and Bohemia, gaining support from these regions. During the war, she demonstrated remarkable leadership, personally visiting the front to boost morale. In 1745, her husband Francis Stephen was elected Holy Roman Emperor, becoming a crucial political ally. The 1748 Treaty of Aachen confirmed her inheritance, but Silesia was lost to Prussia, becoming a source of future conflict.

points.title: 改革与现代化
points.description: 战争结束后，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚专注于国内改革，建立了中央集权的行政体系，重组了军队，改革了税收制度，建立了国家教育系统。她废除了酷刑，改善了司法系统，并推动了医疗卫生改革。1762年她建立了奥地利第一个军事医学院。她还推行了《1750年土地登记法》，试图规范税收并减少贵族特权。这些改革大大增强了奥地利的中央集权和国力，为后来的约瑟夫二世的改革奠定了基础。同时，她与丈夫共同统治，形成了有效的政治伙伴关系。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Maria Theresa focused on domestic reforms, establishing a centralized administrative system, reorganizing the military, reforming taxation, and creating a national education system. She abolished torture, improved the judicial system, and promoted healthcare reforms. In 1762, she established Austria's first military medical academy. She also implemented the 1750 Land Register to standardize taxation and reduce noble privileges. These reforms significantly strengthened Austria's central authority and power, laying the foundation for Joseph II's later reforms. She ruled alongside her husband, forming an effective political partnership.

points.title: 联合统治与外交
points.description: 1765年丈夫弗朗茨·斯蒂芬去世后，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚与长子约瑟夫二世开始联合统治，但两人政策理念常有冲突。她继续推行温和的改革，而约瑟夫则更为激进。在外交方面，她与法国结盟，共同对抗普鲁士。1772年，她参与了第一次瓜分波兰，获得了加利西亚地区，这一决定虽然扩大了奥地利领土，但也引发了道德争议。她试图通过外交手段重建奥地利在德意志地区的霸权，同时保持与匈牙利的良好关系，确保帝国的稳定。
points.descriptionEn: After Francis Stephen's death in 1765, Maria Theresa began joint rule with her eldest son Joseph II, though they often had conflicting policy ideas. She continued with moderate reforms while Joseph favored more radical ones. Diplomatically, she allied with France against Prussia. In 1772, she participated in the First Partition of Poland, gaining Galicia, a decision that expanded Austrian territory but raised moral questions. She attempted to restore Austrian hegemony in Germany through diplomacy while maintaining good relations with Hungary to ensure imperial stability.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 晚年时期，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚继续推行改革，同时平衡与儿子约瑟夫二世的政策冲突。她关注社会福利，建立了孤儿院和济贫院，并改善了农民的处境。1773年她颁布了《教育法》，建立了国家教育体系。尽管健康状况恶化，她仍积极参与政治事务。1780年，她完成了《国家基本法》，试图巩固哈布斯堡王朝的统治。她一生育有16个子女，其中包括后来的法国王后玛丽·安托瓦内特。她的统治结束了哈布斯堡王朝的男性继承传统，开创了女性统治的先河，对欧洲历史产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In her later years, Maria Theresa continued reforms while balancing policy conflicts with her son Joseph II. She focused on social welfare, establishing orphanages and poorhouses, and improving conditions for peasants. In 1773, she issued the Education Act, creating a national education system. Despite declining health, she remained politically active. In 1780, she completed the State Fundamental Law to solidify Habsburg rule. She had 16 children, including future French queen Marie Antoinette. Her reign ended the male-only Habsburg succession tradition, pioneering female rule and profoundly influencing European history.

appraisal.zh: 玛丽亚·特蕾西亚通常被视为18世纪欧洲最具影响力的女性统治者之一，她维护了哈布斯堡王朝的完整，通过中央集权、教育与司法改革增强了奥地利国力，为现代国家奠定基础，其统治被视为奥地利从中世纪向现代过渡的关键阶段。也有研究者指出，她的改革并不彻底，保留了大量封建特权，参与第一次瓜分波兰在道义上受到非议，对普鲁士的强硬政策消耗国力，宗教政策亦偏于保守。维护传统与推动改革在她身上并存，正是其历史形象的复杂之处。
appraisal.en: Maria Theresa is usually regarded as one of the most influential female rulers of 18th-century Europe: she preserved the Habsburg monarchy, strengthened Austria through centralizing, educational and judicial reforms, and her reign is seen as a crucial transition from medieval to modern statehood. Yet researchers also note that her reforms were incomplete and left many feudal privileges intact, that her part in the First Partition of Poland drew moral censure, that her hardline policy toward Prussia drained resources, and that her religious policy remained conservative. Defender of tradition and promoter of reform at once, she is a genuinely complex figure.

supporter.zh: 玛丽亚·特蕾西亚被视为一位杰出的女性统治者和改革家。她成功维护了哈布斯堡王朝的完整，通过一系列改革大大增强了奥地利的中央集权和国力。她重视教育、司法和社会福利，建立了现代国家的基础。作为母亲，她培养了一批有影响力的子女，其中包括未来的法国王后。她的统治展示了女性在18世纪欧洲政治中的重要作用，为后来的女性统治者树立了榜样。
supporter.en: Maria Theresa is regarded as an outstanding female ruler and reformer. She successfully preserved the integrity of the Habsburg monarchy and significantly strengthened Austria's central authority and power through a series of reforms. She emphasized education, justice, and social welfare, laying the foundation for a modern state. As a mother, she raised influential children, including the future French queen. Her reign demonstrated the important role of women in 18th-century European politics, setting an example for future female rulers.

critic.zh: 批评者认为玛丽亚·特蕾西亚的统治存在明显局限。她的改革措施往往不够彻底，保留了太多封建特权。参与第一次瓜分波兰的决策被批评为道德沦丧和领土扩张主义。她对普鲁士的强硬政策导致了长期的军事对抗，消耗了大量国家资源。此外，她与儿子约瑟夫二世的政策冲突也反映了统治理念的矛盾。她的宗教政策相对保守，对宗教少数群体的宽容有限，这与启蒙时代的进步思想形成对比。
critic.en: Critics argue that Maria Theresa's rule had significant limitations. Her reforms were often incomplete, retaining too many feudal privileges. Her decision to participate in the First Partition of Poland is criticized as morally reprehensible and expansionist. Her hardline policy toward Prussia led to prolonged military conflict, consuming substantial national resources. Additionally, her policy conflicts with Joseph II reflected contradictions in her ruling philosophy. Her religious policies were relatively conservative, showing limited tolerance for religious minorities, contrasting with progressive Enlightenment thought.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚被视为18世纪欧洲最具影响力的女性统治者之一。她既是传统君主制的维护者，又是改革的推动者，这种矛盾性使她成为复杂的历史人物。她的形象经常被描绘为坚强、务实且富有母性魅力。在流行文化中，她常被 portrayed as a symbol of female authority in a male-dominated world.她的统治时期被视为奥地利从中世纪向现代国家过渡的关键阶段，她的改革为后来的哈布斯堡王朝奠定了基础。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Maria Theresa is regarded as one of the most influential female rulers of 18th-century Europe. She was both a defender of traditional monarchy and a promoter of reforms, making her a complex historical figure. Her image is often portrayed as strong, pragmatic, and maternally appealing. In popular culture, she is frequently depicted as a symbol of female authority in a male-dominated world. Her reign is seen as a crucial transitional period for Austria from medieval to modern statehood, with her reforms laying the foundation for the later Habsburg monarchy.

self.zh: 我宁愿失去我的生命，也不愿放弃我的权利。
self.en: I would rather lose my life than my rights.
